description: This file defines a PHP class 'DatabaseConfigController' within the OrangeHRM HRM System, specifically managing the database configuration step in the installer process. It extends an abstract installer Vue controller and sets up a component for the database configuration screen, as well as managing state for the installer.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigController
classes.description: Handles setting up the database configuration step in the installer process by rendering the database configuration component and managing the installer screen state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the installer view by setting the database configuration component and updating the current installer screen state.
